name: panels-cargo-4-pods-hatch-open
refs: REFERENCE for the sage-green painted metal, its matte soft-lit finish and the rounded rim only. Do not copy its layout.
prompt: A single painted element on a FLAT, uniform magenta ground #FF00FF, nothing else in the picture. The subject: a tall narrow hatch door of sage-green painted metal, hinged on its LEFT edge, swung wide open towards the viewer in a shallow three-quarter view, so we look at the inside face of the door. The inside face holds a recessed case with SIX EMPTY round pod wells arranged in 2 columns by 3 rows, each well about 56 wide by 64 tall in proportion, shallow soft-lit hollows lined in a darker warm grey-green, perfectly empty, nothing in them. At the foot of the door, below the wells, a narrow slim find strip (a shallow horizontal slot, also empty). Calm, matte, soft-lit painted finish like a grown-up game illustration, rounded rim, small hinges on the left. Tall proportions about 160 wide to 260 tall. NO pods, NO eggs, NO creatures, NO text, NO labels, NO hands, NO shadow on the ground, NO frame, NO neon, NO cartoon outline.
